description: Requires an agent API key (Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key). Check whether the session's buyer wallet can fund its escrow before you broadcast. Returns {ready, missing[], actions[]}: missing names each gap (usdc, eth_gas, allowance) and actions holds the exact call that fixes it (a gas shortfall comes back as the faucet call). Reads chain balances only. REST twin: POST /api/v1/data-sessions/{session_id}/funding-package/preflight. Next: data_session_funding_package (self-sign) or data_session_fund.

inputSchema.description: One buyer data session you opened. Owner comes from the key.

session_id.description: UUID of a data session you opened (from data_session_open).
session_id.title: Session Id

inputSchema.title: DataSessionScopedInput
